Subject: Your wrongful termination matter - Complaint No. 1327/2023

Dear Mr. Bansal,

Thank you for meeting us on 6 June 2024 about your dispute with Everest Industries. As we understand it, the employer withheld the last salary.

Our advice is to file a claim for unpaid wages before the labour authority. Please collect the attendance record and the salary slips and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
